sincere: 守時是尊重他人時間、凡事依約依時完成的美德。
ironic: 把自己遲到說成全世界都早到的藝術。

sceneA.caption: 她準時到達約定的茶餐廳，朋友已在等她，大家談笑開懷。
sceneA.imagePrompt: Warm watercolor of a Hong Kong cha chaan teng: a smiling secondary-school girl arriving on time, waving at a friend already seated at a table with two cups of milk tea, soft morning light, busy street outside, no text in image.

sceneB.caption: 媽媽催她快出門，她一邊說「知道啦我會準時」，一邊繼續慢慢執袋出post。
sceneB.imagePrompt: Warm watercolor of a Hong Kong home: a mother by the door pointing at the clock anxiously, while her daughter sits on the sofa smiling at a phone, posting on social media, school bag still half-open and loose, no text in image.

gap: 說的是「我會準時」，做的是遲到也不在乎。
questions: 為何我們常常嘴上說守時，實際卻總要遲到十五分鐘？
遲到者口中的「準時」，和等待者心中的「準時」，是不是兩個世界？
如果有一天全香港的人都遲到，準時算不算一種不禮貌？
modelSentence: 她誇口自己最守時，結果連自己的生日都遲到，還說蛋糕不新鮮。
